title: 348 reproduce stock CompSuite and the entire original H2 Maven suite
description: Use the documented CompSuite reference tools on its first disclosed example. Invoke unchanged main.py --info and --incompat, and each individual old/new test in separate fresh checkouts with genuine original Git tag identities. Also run the whole Maven JUnit suite on the two original revisions. A networkless guest with CPython 3.11.14, Maven 3.6.3 and Temurin 8 uses a serial public Central cache. Collect wrapper exits and strings independently of actual named Surefire testcase records.
expected: Every submitted original Maven process starts. Inspect actual named XML and assertion outcomes even if the wrapper exits zero or its install fails, and report whole-suite totals separately.

resources.notes: Original provider-only run had 454 tests per pin. The standard Maven lifecycle and one combined plus two independent stock CLI attempts share previously downloaded public dependencies.

steps.name: Run stock CLI with the documented tool versions and independent named test worktrees
